edges.reason: msg.sender flows into the internal _transfer for authorization and blacklist checks.
tx.origin is read inside _transfer blacklist require, tying authorization to the origin EOA.
block.timestamp determines the locked time in lock().
block.timestamp comparison gates the unlock() function.
block.timestamp used as swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp used as liquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call.
_getRValues multiplies token amounts by the reflection rate, risking overflow.
_getTValues performs fee multiplications/divisions that can overflow or truncate.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflected fee from _rTotal, shifting the global rate.
_takeLiquidity credits reflected liquidity fees into _rOwned.
_takeWalletFee credits reflected marketing/dev fees into _rOwned.
_transferStandard calls _getTValues to derive fee split.
_transferStandard calls _getRValues to derive reflected amounts.
_transferToExcluded calls _getTValues for the fee split.
_transferToExcluded calls _getRValues for reflected amounts.
_transferFromExcluded calls _getTValues for the fee split.
_transferFromExcluded calls _getRValues for reflected amounts.
_transferBothExcluded calls _getTValues for the fee split.
_transferBothExcluded calls _getRValues for reflected amounts.
_getRate derives the supply pair from _getCurrentSupply.
deliver uses _getTValues to compute fee components before burning.
deliver uses _getRValues to compute the reflected amount removed.
balanceOf returns _tOwned for reward-excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for non-excluded accounts via tokenFromReflection.
lock() moves _owner into _previousOwner and zeroes _owner.
lock() writes block.timestamp + time into _lockTime.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock() reads _lockTime to enforce the lock expiry.
addBotToBlacklist sets the blacklist flag for the account.
addBotToBlacklist pushes the account onto _blackListedBots.
removeBotFromBlacklist clears the blacklist flag for the account.
setBuyFee writes into the buyFee struct fields.
setSellFee writes into the sellFee struct fields.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes and stores _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSizePercent recomputes and stores _maxWalletSize.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled toggles the swapAndLiquifyEnabled flag.
constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router.
constructor creates and assigns the uniswapV2Pair.
constructor sets _tTotal from the supplied token supply.
constructor derives and sets _rTotal from _tTotal.
updateDevWallet reassigns the _devwallet address.
updateMarketingWallet reassigns the _marketingAddress.
inSwapAndLiquify guard flag is read and written by the lockTheSwap modifier on swapAndLiquify.
tAmount parameter feeds _getTValues fee computation.
amount parameter is validated and forwarded by _transfer.
from parameter drives source-side checks inside _transfer.
to parameter drives destination-side checks and swap trigger inside _transfer.
time parameter is added to block.timestamp in lock().
account parameter is the target of addBotToBlacklist.
local tTransferAmount is emitted and credited in _transferStandard.
local rAmount is subtracted from sender _rOwned in _transferStandard.
local contractTokenBalance decides whether swapAndLiquify is invoked in _transfer.
local currentRate is the multiplier input used by _getRValues.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer to execute fee-aware accounting.
_tokenTransfer branches to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded.
_tokenTransfer branches to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer branches to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer branches to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded.
_tokenTransfer calls setBuy when the sender is the uniswap pair.
_tokenTransfer calls setSell when the recipient is the uniswap pair.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert the swap portion to ETH.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity to pair tokens with received ETH.
swapAndLiquify transfers the marketing share of ETH to _marketingAddress.
swapAndLiquify transfers the dev share of ETH to _devwallet.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to apply the reflection reduction.
_transferStandard calls _takeLiquidity for the liquidity fee.
_transferStandard calls _takeWalletFee for the marketing/dev fee.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer before adjusting allowance.
The external router swap re-enters the token ERC20 transfer path, so the swap is a reentrancy callback vector.

normalization_plan.reason: tAmount only exists to feed the private fee computation, so it can be folded into _getTValues.
The amount parameter is consumed exclusively by _transfer for validation and accounting.
The from parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer source-side logic.
The to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer destination-side logic.
The time parameter is only used to compute _lockTime inside lock().
The account parameter is the direct target of blacklist mutation in addBotToBlacklist.
tTransferAmount is a transient local produced and consumed inside _transferStandard.
rAmount is a transient local produced and consumed inside _transferStandard.
contractTokenBalance only lives inside _transfer to gate the swapAndLiquify call.
currentRate is a transient rate value passed into _getRValues for reflected math.
